name: RDD2022
description: Road-surface images from six countries for detecting pavement cracks, potholes, and repairs, from the multinational RDD2022 benchmark. Captured with car-mounted smartphones in Japan, India, and the Czech Republic, a survey vehicle in Norway, Google Street View in the US, and motorbike and drone cameras in China; released for the CRDDC 2022 challenge. Source: Arya et al., "RDD2022: A multi-national image dataset for automatic road damage detection," Geoscience Data Journal 2024; github.com/sekilab/RoadDamageDetector.
